items.quote: Built with AI at its core, Zoho CRM supercharges your business to get ahead without the overhead.
items.why: Says CRM and AI, but not sales, leads, deals or automation.

items.quote: The Zoho CRM API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
items.why: States Zoho CRM API uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication.

items.quote: Applications that does not have a redirect URL or a web UI, operating solely in the backend without requiring user interaction.
items.why: Describes only the backend/self-client type, not the full oauth2 claim.
Table row shows Free Edition credits; says nothing about self-serve credential registration.

items.quote: The API limits for trial editions are the same as those of their corresponding paid editions.
items.why: Trial limits match paid, but does not address the self-serve gate.

items.quote: Perform CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application through flexible RESTful endpoints.
items.why: States REST endpoints with CRUD on modules; the broad-breadth detail is not covered.

items.quote: Combine up to five API calls in a single request through this API.
items.why: Confirms the Composite family (up to five calls) only, one piece of the claim.

items.quote: Connect your AI tools to Zoho CRM using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to perform CRM operations using natural language.
items.why: Zoho doc says it connects AI tools via MCP, implying an official MCP offering.

items.quote: When you invoke an MCP tool for the first time, the server initiates an OAuth flow.
items.why: Implies an MCP server exists via its OAuth flow, but does not state it.
